saw_lines: Record buyers hunt one specific pressing, by label, country or catalog number, and they check the price before they click.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a collector checks whether you have the exact pressing.
Your 25 ads show no proof number, so buyers have no number to trust. Collect one figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
